clinical_study.brief_title: A Study of Investigational Drug X in Adults With Moderate to Severe Rheumatoid Arthritis
clinical_study.official_title: A Randomized, Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled Study of Drug X in Adults With Moderate to Severe Rheumatoid Arthritis and Inadequate Response to Methotrexate

criteria.textblock:
Inclusion Criteria:
- Age 18 to 75 years
- Diagnosis of rheumatoid arthritis for at least 6 months
- Inadequate response to methotrexate
- ALT and AST less than 2.5 x ULN
- eGFR at least 45 mL/min/1.73m2
Exclusion Criteria:
- Active or latent tuberculosis
- Pregnant or nursing women
- Prior treatment with more than one biologic DMARD
- Platelet count less than 100 x10^9/L

brief_summary.textblock: This study evaluates the efficacy and safety of Drug X versus placebo in adults with moderate to severe rheumatoid arthritis who have had an inadequate response to methotrexate.

detailed_description.textblock: Participants will be randomized 1:1 to receive Drug X or matching placebo, in addition to background methotrexate, for 24 weeks.
